projects.title: Circuit Breakers
projects.award: Best Thesis · Best Paper · Best Presenter
projects.blurb: A 2D roguelike that teaches cybersecurity through play. Lead author on the award-winning paper; ran the numerical balancing across gameplay and database systems.
projects.summary: Circuit Breakers is a 2D PC roguelike that turns cybersecurity concepts into roguelike runs. As lead author I owned the award-winning thesis and technical documentation, executed the numerical balancing for gameplay and the Firebase-backed database systems, and built functionality spanning UI, mechanics, and progression. It won Best Thesis, Best Paper, and Best Presenter.
highlights: Lead author on the award-winning thesis & technical documentation
Numerical balancing across gameplay and database systems
Built features from UI and buttons to core mechanics
Firebase auth, stats, and achievements integration

projects.title: Fightmap Generator
projects.tagline: Procedural battle-map generator · Python · CLI + GUI
projects.blurb: A dependency-light procedural generator for top-down tabletop battle maps — six layout types across three themes, rendered to PNG with seeded, reproducible output. Ships with both a CLI and a one-click desktop app.
projects.summary: Fightmap Generator is a procedural (not AI/ML) battle-map generator written in Python. A map is a 2D grid of tile types produced by plain algorithms — room placement, corridor carving, and seeded value-noise scatter — then rendered in layers: noise-textured ground, raised objects with drop-shadows, warm light glow, and a fog/vignette mood pass. Six layout archetypes (settlement, arena, dungeon, tomb, forest, wildlands) each render under any of three data-driven themes for 18 combinations, and a flood-fill connectivity guarantee ensures no walkable area is ever stranded. A single numpy Generator is threaded through both generation and rendering, so the same seed reproduces byte-identical output. It runs as a CLI or a tkinter desktop app (packageable into a standalone Windows .exe), backed by a pytest suite covering tile/theme integrity, connectivity, noise determinism, reproducibility, the full type×theme matrix, and the CLI.
highlights: Six layout types × three themes (18 combinations) from pure algorithms — no AI/ML
Seeded numpy RNG threaded through generation and rendering: same seed = byte-identical map
Layered renderer: noise-textured ground, raised objects with drop-shadows, light glow, fog/vignette
Flood-fill connectivity guarantee — no walkable region is ever stranded
CLI + tkinter desktop GUI, packageable to a standalone Windows .exe

projects.title: The Canrael Codex
projects.tagline: Dark-fantasy quote generator · a creative-support tool
projects.blurb: My most ambitious static site — a Canrael quote generator and worldbuilding companion: 281 hand-written quotes across 8 regions, each with its own concept-art backdrop and ambient score.
projects.summary: The Canrael Codex is a dark-fantasy quote generator built as a creative-support backbone for my worldbuilding. Draw from 281 hand-written ‘whispers’ — anonymous voices from across the continents — and filter by 8 regions of Canrael, each of which shifts the site's concept-art backdrop and ambient music to match (the Abyss, Frosthold, Ankari, Miran, and more). Aged-parchment and silver-blue Aetherflame styling over original concept art, keyboard shortcuts (Space to draw, C to copy/inscribe), region-themed Web Audio ambience, and an ember particle field — fully static and responsive, with no build step or dependencies.
highlights: 281 hand-written quotes spanning the world's many voices
8 region filters, each with its own concept-art backdrop + ambient score
Region-themed Web Audio ambience that shifts with your selection
Aged-parchment / Aetherflame art direction over original concept art
Keyboard shortcuts, fully responsive, zero dependencies

projects.title: Haiku Daily
projects.tagline: Static site · one classical haiku per day · living sumi-e scene
projects.blurb: A living sumi-e night scene that surfaces one public-domain haiku per day — brush-written line by line, with parallax Mt Fuji, fireflies, drifting petals, and a koto soundscape.
projects.summary: A zero-dependency static site that surfaces one public-domain haiku per day from the classical masters — Bashō, Issa, Buson, Chiyo-ni — chosen deterministically from the calendar date. It opens with a shoji-screen intro (the title brush-writes on, a seal stamps down) over a living sumi-e night scene: parallax Mt Fuji, a glowing moon, drifting clouds and mist, falling sakura petals, fireflies, and swaying paper lanterns, with each haiku brush-written line by line. Audio unlocks on first interaction — a looping koto track (‘Moonlit Koto Garden’) with a synthesized koto/shakuhachi fallback, plus quiet synth UI effects (entry bell, bamboo shishi-odoshi clack, brush ticks, seal thunk) that are ducked, rate-limited, and remembered. Keyboard controls and a prefers-reduced-motion fallback. No build step, no dependencies.
highlights: Deterministic daily haiku chosen from the calendar date
Living sumi-e scene: parallax Mt Fuji, fireflies, petals, lanterns
Looping koto track with a synthesized koto/shakuhachi fallback
Shoji-screen intro + character-by-character brush calligraphy
Keyboard controls + prefers-reduced-motion fallback

projects.title: 江湖箴言 · Jianghu Proverbs
projects.tagline: Static site · 200 attributed Chinese proverbs · living wuxia scene
projects.blurb: A living wuxia/murim silk-scroll that rolls a random Chinese proverb from 200 classics — with animated scenery, looping music, a synthesized Web Audio soundscape, and brush-on-screen calligraphy.
projects.summary: A single-page static site staged as a living wuxia/murim scene — a hanging silk scroll on aged rice paper, swaying red lanterns, parallax mountains with a distant pagoda, a breathing moon, and falling plum-blossom petals. It rolls a random proverb from 200 classics across 79 sources (Confucius, Laozi, Sun Tzu, Li Bai, the Water Margin, and more) with original text, pinyin, English, and full attribution. Each draw slashes a glint across the paper, brush-writes the proverb character by character, and stamps an index seal. A click-to-enter gate unlocks audio: a looping erhu-style track ('Silent Bamboo Path', lazy-loaded) plus a fully synthesized Web Audio soundscape — temple bell, fortune-stick rattle, sword glint, brush ticks, and seal thunk — all generated live, rate-limited, and ducked beneath the music. No build step, no dependencies.
highlights: 200 attributed proverbs across 79 sources
Looping music + fully synthesized Web Audio soundscape (no sound files)
Animated scenery: parallax mountains, swaying lanterns, petals, breathing moon
Cinematic opening sequence + character-by-character brush calligraphy
Keyboard controls + prefers-reduced-motion fallback

projects.title: Melanoma Skin Cancer Detection
projects.blurb: A CNN that classifies dermoscopic images as benign or malignant at 90%+ accuracy, with experiments comparing optimizers and activation functions.
projects.summary: A convolutional neural network built in TensorFlow/Keras that classifies dermoscopic images as benign or malignant at over 90% accuracy. I engineered and ran several experimental iterations — comparing optimizers and activation functions — to identify the most stable convergence patterns, all documented in the notebook. The shared Drive folder bundles the trained model, saved checkpoints, the dataset, and the base notebooks.
highlights: 90%+ classification accuracy on benign vs. malignant
Comparative experiments across optimizers and activation functions
Convergence-stability analysis to pick the strongest configuration
Reproducible notebook + saved model checkpoints

projects.title: Library Management System
projects.blurb: A library platform tracking books, users, and activity across Admin, Librarian, and Borrower roles, with activity logging and transaction records.
projects.summary: A web platform that tracks books, users, and activity across three roles — Admin, Librarian, and Borrower. I built the CRUD systems, user-activity logging, and transaction records, and designed the interactions and feedback flows between all three user types.
highlights: Three role types: Admin, Librarian, Borrower
Full CRUD for books and users
User-activity logging and transaction records
Cross-role interaction and feedback flows
